messages:
tariq: Quick note — we started seeing a tail-latency regression on the Mistral-12B FP8 build under sustained concurrency (50-150 qps). Looks like KV cache churn + kernel selector fallback combo.
ashley: Ugh, can you paste the perf trace? Is this on AWQ-quantized weights or GPTQ variants? :eyes:
benji: AWQ, fp8 path. Kernel selector logs show repeated fallback to `matmul_generic` around the same time as KV eviction spikes. snippet from runtime log:
```
[2026-03-15T11:22:08Z] kernel_selector: chosen=fp8_opt_gemm
[2026-03-15T11:22:08Z] kernel_selector: fallback=matmul_generic (reason=kernel_not_supported for seq_len=2048)
[2026-03-15T11:22:09Z] kv_cache: evict=128 entries, active=512 -> 384
[2026-03-15T11:22:09Z] batcher: microbatch_split=4 -> 8 (backpressure)
```
li: That fallback + eviction loop rings like RoPE scaling mismatch to me — when rotary scaling is off for a model variant, our prefix KV lookups can mismatch and blow up cache hits. Did we roll any RoPE param updates in the model package?
eva: We did push a RoPE-normalization tweak last week for Mistral-12B FP8 (to align with AWQ calibration). I ran the calibration prompts but only on the short-prompt suite. Perf results on the eval set show a tiny accuracy delta but big latency variance:
- baseline AWQ (no RoPE tweak): avg lat 48ms p95 120ms
- post-tweak FP8: avg lat 52ms p95 310ms (+ huge tail)
perf-bot: [regression] metric=tail_latency_p95, model=mistral-12b-fp8, delta=+190ms, alert_id=R-20260315-004
ashley: Can we reproduce with a synthetic trace? If the batcher is splitting microbatches more often, maybe the scheduler is creating more short-lived KV segments and that triggers slower kernel selection because of sequence len variability.
benji: Repro steps I used: spawn 60 clients (parrot traffic), prompt length mix 64/512/2048, quant=AWQ-FP8, kernel selector debug on. Observed 2 things: 1) seq_len spikes cause fallback decisions, 2) fallback path has about 2.8x worse per-token perf on our GPU.
li: Quick check — does the kernel selector use the same profiling table for AWQ-FP8? We have a known hole where fp8_opt_gemm wasn't annotated for long-seq RoPE-shifted heads for Mixtral-derived layouts. That would explain chosen->fallback churn.
tariq: Good call. I believe the layout change was part of the Mixtral import pipeline we merged last sprint. Could be a mismatch between compiled kernels and the model layout metadata.
infrastructure note (infra-oncall): I'm standing up a repro cluster now (g5x2), will attach traces to the thread. ETA ~15m.
eva: Also worth checking calibration prompts — I have the short suite and a long-rope suite. The long-rope calibration shows a ~0.6% accuracy delta on a handful of prompts for AWQ-FP8 vs GPTQ-int8. If we re-run calibration with the long-rope set we can see if the RoPE tweak regresses the accuracy or just the latency.
ashley: Action items:
• benji + li: bisect kernel selector policy vs layout metadata (owner: benji)
• eva: rerun AWQ calibration with long-rope prompts and post accuracy table (owner: eva)
• tariq + infra-oncall: repro cluster + perf traces (owner: tariq)
Please ping here with short logs (kernel_selector lines, kv_cache sizes, batcher decisions). If we confirm it's a metadata->kernel mismatch we can hotfix selector table and backfill a small kernel shim. :thumbsup:
benji: Will also try forcing `kernel_hint=fp8_opt_gemm` to see if that stabilizes tails (not a permanent fix, but will test impact).
perf-bot: [info] run=trace-2367890123 attached to R-20260315-004 (s3://perf-traces/mistral/2367890123.tar.gz)
infra-oncall: repro cluster up, attaching flamegraph + kernel selection timeline in ~5m.
tariq: thanks all — keep updates short here. If anyone sees accuracy regressions >0.5% from calibration reruns, flag immediately and I'll open a rollback for the RoPE tweak.
